newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA TO FIELD FOUR NEW CAPS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA TO FIELD FOUR NEW CAPS.

text.p: Western Samoa will field four new caps, including former New Zealand wing Va'aiga Tuigamala, against Ireland at Lansdowne Road on Tuesday.
The other newcomers are right-wing Osato So'oala, fly-half Earl Va'a and loose forward Isaac Feaunati.
Loose-head prop Nick Popplewell has been ruled out of the Ireland team because of a hamstring strain.
Moseley's Henry Hurley, who won one cap as a replacement against Fiji last season, moves up from the replacements to take over from Popplewell, who sustained his injury in training on Saturday.
